verdict.rationale: Alacritty's README explicitly delegates tabs and splits to 'a window manager or terminal multiplexer', so running tmux inside it is the intended workflow. It does not offer a native tmux control mode. One hands-on report notes tmux/neovim shortcuts failed under WSL2 after TOML config gotchas. That is a configuration caveat, not proof tmux cannot run. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on running tmux (terminfo, keybinding guidance), native tmux integration/control mode, positive independent corroboration of smooth tmux use.
